name: Switch to ONE
supporting_messages: Stop paying separately for fragmented tools.
Bring your work with you. Keep your files portable.
Built in Africa for the world.
AI, productivity, creativity, education and business tools under one account.
calls_to_action: Invite someone who should stop overpaying

organic_sequence.goal: Show the cost-fragmentation problem without publishing unproven final pricing
Drive verified registrations through privacy-preserving sharing and owned channels

paid_media_policy: No broad paid launch until D7/D30 retention and cost-per-active-account are measurable. All paid campaigns remain approval-gated in Growth OS.
